summary: Set the DOM stop-propagation flag without suppressing other listeners on the current target.

semantics.effect: prevents further propagation to later targets/phases
semantics.same_target: does not by itself prevent other listeners on current target

caveats: Do not implement as stopImmediatePropagation; same-target listeners must remain eligible.

tests.name: other same-target listener still runs
tests.input: const t=new EventTarget(); let a=[]; t.addEventListener('x',e=>{a.push(1);e.stopPropagation()}); t.addEventListener('x',()=>a.push(2)); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('x')); console.log(a.join(','));
